context: A boss reviews a wedding-reception plan with his assistant
purpose: Teach: 関数/スポット/正面/披露/打つ/秩序/規約/日付

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 披露宴の進行表、できたか？日付は来月の十五日で確定だ。
lines.en: Is the reception schedule ready? The date is confirmed for the fifteenth of next month.
lines.style: Direct boss tone, clipped sentences, confirming logistics with mild impatience.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、こちらです。会場の正面玄関で受付を行う予定になっております。
lines.en: Yes, here it is. We're planning to hold the reception at the venue's main front entrance.
lines.style: Polite office Japanese with humble verb forms and careful formal phrasing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 写真スポットは？新郎新婦が一番映える場所を確保しておけよ。
lines.en: What about photo spots? Make sure to secure the place where the bride and groom look best.
lines.style: Gives instructions abruptly, ending with a casual imperative typical of senior men.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 庭園の噴水前を押さえました。あと、座席表の規約についてご相談が。
lines.en: I've reserved the area in front of the fountain. Also, I'd like to consult about the seating rules.
lines.style: Reports completion concisely then pivots smoothly to a new agenda item.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 席順は秩序が大事だ。親族と上司の並びを間違えると角が立つぞ。
lines.en: Seating order is about hierarchy. If we mix up relatives and supervisors, feelings will get hurt.
lines.style: Lectures with traditional workplace wisdom, blunt warning at the end.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 承知しております。エクセルの関数で自動的に並ぶよう設定しました。
lines.en: I understand. I've set it up so an Excel function arranges them automatically.
lines.style: Reassuring competence with a touch of quiet technical pride.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ほう、やるじゃないか。じゃあ今すぐ司会者にメールを打ってくれ。
lines.en: Oh, not bad at all. Then go ahead and shoot the emcee an email right now.
lines.style: Begrudging praise followed by another immediate task, typical brisk boss energy.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: かしこまりました。文面を打つ前に、確認事項を一つお伺いしてもよろしいでしょうか。
lines.en: Certainly. Before I type out the message, may I ask you one item I need to confirm?
lines.style: Anticipates the next step proactively, very polished assistant register with deferential clarification.
